description: The Mahuika-Auckland research team publishes a carbon dioxide emissions product for Auckland, New Zealand, based on the city's 2016 greenhouse-gas and air-emission inventories. Eighteen NetCDF files give annual totals and hourly patterns on a 500 metre grid. Fossil-fuel sources are separated into roads, industrial activity, commercial activity, homes, aviation and shipping. A large steelworks is held in a separate point-source file, while waste and wood burning appear as biogenic emissions. Zenodo supplies the files without charge under CC-BY-4.0. Several hourly sectors contain only one representative day or weekday, so the archive does not provide an independent full year of hour-by-hour measurements for every source. The residential layer does contain a full hourly year. These estimates can supply emissions and air-quality boundary conditions for transport, urban-energy and industrial simulations. They complement land and population inputs, but they should not be mistaken for measured emissions at each grid cell. No NetCDF file was downloaded.
